note: S235 arc audit, verified against live code after S234. Priority favored visitor-facing conversion, AI agent usefulness, and observability truth. No fabricated field data: INP remains data-blocked because data/inp-breakdown.json has zero samples.

items.title: Oracle prebaked answer corpus plus agent-callable lookup endpoint
items.why: assets/ignis-answer-engine.js had a keyword-only client answer path and agents.json did not expose a source-backed answer lookup. The site promises human and AI agent usefulness, so the Oracle needs deterministic answers that cost nothing at runtime and cite public sources.
items.recipe: Build scripts/build-oracle-answers.mjs from api/oracle-insights.json and api/membership-tiers.json, commit oracle/answers/index.json, load it before the client fallback, advertise it in agents.json actions/feeds and .well-known/llms.txt, and gate it with self-test plus --check in check-proof-surface.

items.title: Interactive membership value calculator on /membership-value/
items.why: membership-value/ had static value copy. A calculator lets a visitor select actual intended use, compares it to $4.99/mo from the canonical tier JSON, and emits UX telemetry when computed.
items.recipe: Add assets/membership-value-calculator.js, mount it in membership-value/index.html, source tier facts from /api/membership-tiers.json, and keep the static no-JS fallback.

items.title: Startup brief truth fixes for last-active, revenue signal, and SIL forecast
items.why: The /start brief claimed Last active: 20632d, projected SIL 0/1000, and alarmed on a missing local revenue signal. Those are observability lies created by parser/source assumptions, not project reality.
items.recipe: Stop treating numeric silLastSession as a date, make a missing local revenue file neutral rather than stale, and teach the SIL forecaster to parse compact v3 category lines.
evidence: scripts/lib/sil-forecaster.mjs now predicts from recent v3 sessions

items.title: Second-order quality gate for generated Oracle prose
items.why: The first generated corpus passed schema checks while producing raw concatenated source prose. The generator needed a quality-oriented root fix so deterministic answers stay readable.
items.recipe: Fix cleanText truncation, filter stopword keywords, keep source snippets in structured citations instead of stuffing them into answer bodies, and assert production corpus safety before writing/checking output.
evidence: clean Oracle answer samples now keep complete sentences and cited source page names
self-test fixture and production --check both pass

items.title: Deploy the agent-aware Cloudflare Worker user-agent policy
items.why: S234 shipped code that allows generic HTTP clients on public reads while still blocking scanner tools. The remaining premise is deployment, not source implementation.
items.recipe: Run the existing wrangler production deploy through the normal approval/network gates, then verify production headers and agent access behavior.
evidence: cloudflare/security-headers-worker.js contains the split scanner/generic HTTP policy
npm run deploy maps to wrangler deploy --env production --config cloudflare/wrangler.toml

items.title: INP root fix remains data-blocked until real interaction samples exist
items.why: data/inp-breakdown.json currently has totalSamples: 0 and no route breakdown. Any claimed INP root fix would be fabricated without route/handler evidence.
items.recipe: Keep the telemetry path live, wait for real field samples, then fix the highest route/handler contributor instead of guessing.

items.title: Report Studio Ops profile mismatch without editing a sibling repo
items.why: studio-ops arc-profile/check-canon-conformance classified this public live website as infrastructure/internal/FORGE even though local PROJECT_STATUS.json says website/public-live/SPARKED. That makes conformance output noisy and can hide the right public-site checks.
items.recipe: Ship Ark cargo to studio-ops with the mismatch evidence; do not directly edit the sibling repo tree from this project.
evidence: PROJECT_STATUS.json type website, audience public-live, vaultStatus SPARKED

items.title: Second-order LLM discovery spine for Oracle answers
items.why: Adding a JSON endpoint is not enough if agent discovery surfaces do not point to it. The answer corpus should be visible from both agents.json and llms.txt.
items.recipe: Expose oracle/answers/index.json in agents.json feeds/actions and .well-known/llms.txt canonical surfaces.
evidence: agents.json includes Oracle prebaked answers feed and oracle.answer.lookup action
